text:
maria: RFC follow-up: proposing a "local shim" pattern so the kube liveness/readiness probes remain lightweight while verification + HSM/KMS interactions happen asynchronously. Need buy-in on state machine and operator gating rules.
aj: Saw a customer site where USB seed + HSM quote took ~5m. Kube killed sidecar; cluster never finished activation.
kevin: +1. We should avoid extending kube liveness timeouts globally. Better to change what probes check.
ben: Proposal sketch: agent creates a small unix-socket control plane + file markers under /var/lib/redwood/agent_state. Liveness checks socket + bootstrap marker (fast). Heavy verification runs in background and writes a signed "claim" file once >N successes seen. Operator reads just the hash of the signed claim.
ops-bot: Event: pod/agent-abc liveness probe failed at 15:03:12; restart_count=1; reason=readiness failed (verifier-unreachable).
maria: Right. Concrete states: START -> BOOTSTRAPPED -> VERIFYING -> VERIFIED -> ACTIVE; plus DEGRADED fallback. Kube sees BOOTSTRAPPED as healthy. Activation controller requires VERIFIED before flipping active.
aj: How to avoid brief network blips promoting VERIFIED then dropping? Use a promotion window: require 3 consecutive verifier handshakes within 120s. Rollback to VERIFYING only after 2 consecutive failures within 60s.
kevin: Operator CRD status additions (status only): activationState, verifierWindowSuccesses, verifierWindowFailures, lastVerifierCheckTs, verifierHash. No raw tokens in CRD.
ben: Security: claim file must be signed by agent private key (or HSM) so operator can validate authenticity offline. For on-prem HSMs the agent will produce the claim but operator may reconcile it later during manual verification.
sre: Observability: expose metrics: redwood_agent_verifier_checks_total, redwood_agent_verifier_success_total, redwood_agent_state{state="bootstrapped"|"verifying"|"verified"|"degraded"}. Dashboards should show pending activations per-cluster.
maria: Admin flow: allow spec.activation.force=true annotation to let an operator perform manual activation (RBAC + audit log entry). Should only be available to a small admin role.
aj: Edge-case: node reboot leaves leftover bootstrap marker. Agent startup must verify marker version and cleanup stale tokens. Idea: agent writes versioned token with image tag + boot-id. Liveness probe looks for token matching current image tag.
kevin: Probe example (tiny):
```bash
# /usr/local/bin/redwood-liveness.sh
file=/var/lib/redwood/agent_state/bootstrap-v$(cat /etc/redwood/image-tag 2>/dev/null)
[ -S /var/run/redwood/control.sock ] && [ -f "$file" ] && exit 0
exit 1
```
ben: For HSM-only customers we add an offline-attest path: agent writes attest-to-disk + operator has a reconcile mode that reads attests from a secure share when a verifier appliance is later connected. This decouples long HSM ops from pod liveness.
sre: Tests: add an e2e that simulates a 4m seed copy + intermittent network; assert operator does NOT restart pods and activation remains in VERIFYING until verified, then flips. Also add unit tests for sliding-window counters persisted across restarts.
maria: UX: readiness endpoint should stream a short line of progress: "verifier: attempting (3/3)" so redwoodctl and console can show progress without exposing secrets. Operator should surface ETA heuristics and a link to logs.
aj: Implementation responsibilities:
- agent: implement file markers, signed claims, control socket, metrics (aj + kevin)
- operator: CRD status fields + gating + manual override UI (ben + sre)
- docs: migration notes + e2e (maria)
kevin: One more thought: for large clusters allow policy "partial-activate": operator can activate a fraction of replicas into a degraded path if policy allows, with clear UI for reduced trust. Useful for emergency rollouts.
ben: We'll need to document security implications and audit trail for partial-activate. Also provide a way to revoke a claim if HSM key rotation occurs.
sre: Ops checklist for RFC: default liveness -> local shim file/socket, operator gating on verified, sliding-window promotion rules, metrics + alerts, manual override RBAC, migration job to scrub stale markers, e2e test.
maria: OK I'll update the RFC with state machine diagram, CRD status patch, probe snippets, and e2e plan. Aiming for reviewers by COB Wed. Ping me if you want to take a section. Thanks. :thumbsup:
